name: Section 15. Grievances
text: SECTION 15 Grievances Any employee claiming to have been discharged without just cause or otherwise deprived of or injured with respect to any of the rights conferred © upon him hereunder may have such claim ‘taken up on his behalf with his employer through the appropriate Union representatives; and in the event such claim is not satisfactorily adjusted, the Union may submit the same to the Joint Standing Committee and/or Appeals Board.

name: 16-A. Referral of Grievances
text: SECTION 16 Joint Standing Committee and Appeals Board 16-A, All grievances, differences and disputes 59 FUNDOO00954 arising out of the interpretation or application of this Agreement which cannot be settled at the plant level are to be referred in writing and as hereinafter provided, to the Joint Standing Committee and/or the Appeals Board within thirty (30) days after the grieving party knew, or with reasonable diligence should have known, of the existence of the facts or circumstances giving rise to the grievance. Any grievances, differences, or disputes not so referred shall be deemed to have been waived except to the extent that such grievances may be found to be continuing grievances, in ‘which case only the claims for damages or other relief, for events occurring more than thirty (30) days prior to the written grievance shall be deemed to have been waived.

name: 16-B. Joint Standing Committee
text: 16-B. The parties hereto hereby create a Joint Standing Committee. which shall consist of two (2) members designated by the Union and two (2) members designated by the Publishers’ Association of New York City. Immediately after the effective date hereof, the parties hereto shall, in writing, designate their respective members of the Committee and shall have the right, without notice, from time to time to change such designations and/or to designate substitute members.

name: 16-C. Authority of Joint Standing Committee
text: 16-C. The Joint Standing Committee shal] have full and complete authority, in accordance with the provisions of this section, and any decision when reduced to writing and subscribed to by a majority of the members of the Committee shall be binding upon the parties hereto and shall be enforceable as an arbitration award in any court 60 wm ae oe he mare me Te ee ae ey of competent jurisdiction, The Joint Standing Committee shall have no more than two (2) weeks after the submission of any matter to the Committee to reach a decision with respect to the submitted issue and to take action thereon.

name: 16-D. Appeals Board
text: 16-D. In the event that the Joint Standing Committee is unable to resolve the issue, or fails to act within two (2) weeks after submission, the matter shall then be automatically referred to the Appeals Board which shall consist of the four (4) members of the Joint Standing Committee and a chairman who shall be selected in accordance with the procedure hereinafter set forth.

name: 16-E. 1. (a) Impartial Chairman Selection
text: 16-E. 1. (a) Immediately after each such matter has been referred to the Appeals Board, the parties shall select a fifth impartial member of the Appeals Board, who shall serve as Chairman. The fifth impartial member shall be the first arbitrator selected by random method agreeable to the parties from the list compiled in accordance with 16-E. 2. below who is available to hear the matter within thirty (30) dzeys of his selection. The Appeals Board so constituted shall hear and decide the particular matter referred to it in accordance with the rules and regulations for arbitration adopted by the Union and the Publishers’ Association.

name: 16-E. 1. (b) Disciplinary Case Arbitrator Selection
text: (b) If, in a disciplinary suspension or discharge case, no arbitrator listed in Section 16-E. 1. of the parties’ Agreement is available to hear the case within thirty (80) days after his selection, the Union may elect to select an arbitrator for such case by requesting a panel of nine (9) arbitrators 61 FUNDO000955 available to hear the matter within thirty (80) days or less from the American Arbitration Association and proceeding as provided herein. Such election shall be made by letter delivered to the Publisher within five (5) days after the date it is determined that none of the arbitrators listed in Section 16-E. 1. is available within thirty (80) days. When the panel of arbitrators is received, representatives of the Publisher and the Union shall meet within five (5) days after such receipt and at such meeting alternatively strike names from the panel until only one (1) name remains, who: shall be the arbitrator for the given case. The first party to strike from the panel shall be determined by coin flip. Such arbitrator and the arbitration of the given case shall in all respects, other than this selection procedure, be governed by the parties’ Agreement and the Arbitration rules.

name: 16-E. 2. Selection of Fifteen Arbitrators
text: 16-E. 2. Immediately after the execution of this Agreement, the parties hereto shall meet to select fifteen (15) impartial arbitrators to serve on the Hst called for in paragraph 16-E. 1, and their names shall be entered on said list in order of their selection. In the event that the parties fail to designate the fifteen (15) impartial arbitrators within sixty (60) days after the signing of this Agreement, any or all of such impartial arbitrators remaining to be designated shall be selected from separate lists of at least five names each, supplied by the American Arbitration Assoelation for each such arbitrator to be selected, in accordance with the then controlling AAA rules and regulations governing such selection. No name may appear on more than one list. 62 In the event of death or resignation, or if an arbitrator is incapacitated or otherwise unable or unwilling to serve, a new arbitrator shall be chosen in his place by mutual agreement or, if the parties are unable to agree, by the procedures of 16-E. 2. above.

name: 16-E. 3. Striking Arbitrators
text: 16-E. 3. On June 1, 1982 and again on June 1, 1988, both parties shall have the right to strike up to five arbitrators from the existing Hst of fifteen arbitrators in paragraph 16-E. 1. New arbitrators shall be immediately chosen by mutual agreement to replace the names eliminated by both parties. If the parties are unable to agree on any or all of the replacements, the replacements remaining to be designated shall be selected following the procedures of paragraph 16-E. 2. above,

name: 16-F. Appeals Board Quorum
text: 16-F. The chairman and any two other mem-~ bers of the Appeals Board shall constitute a quorum thereof for all purposes. The absence of any member or a vacancy on the Board shall not preclude the Appeals Board from making a decision and taking action on any matter so long as such quo1em is present.

name: 16-G. Term of Impartial Chairmen
text: 16..G. The term of the permanent impartial chairmen designated under Section 16-M. shall termina.e upon the expiration of this Agreement.

name: 16-H. The Adjustment Board
text: The Adjustment Board 16-H. In addition to the Joint Standing Committee and Appeals Board herein created, there shall be an Adjustment Board .consisting of two (2) members designated by the Union and two (2) members designated. by the Publishers’ Assccia- 63 FUNDOO00956 tion of New York City, which shall have exclusive jurisdiction over any issue arising with regard to the provisions of Section 4-A of this agreement. The decisions of a majority of said Adjustment Board shall be binding upon the parties hereto and shall be enforceable as an arbitration award in any court of competent jurisdiction. In the event the Adjustment Board is unable to reach a decision, the matter shall be referred to the Appeals Board in the manner prescribed.

name: 16-I. Rules of Procedure
text: 16-I, The Adjustment Board, the Joint Stand- ing Committee and the Appeals Board may from time to time make, modify, repeal, supplement and amend rules governing their respective procedures, and no record need be kept of any proceeding unless the Committee or Boards otherwise determine pursuant to their own rules.

name: 16-J. Failure to Appear
text: 16-J. Failure of any party involved to appear before the Adjustment Board, the Joint Standing Committee or the Appeals Board after written notice of not less than three (3) days shall not preclude the Adjustment Board, the Joint Standing Committee or the Appeals Board from considering the case and from making a decision thereon.

name: 16-K. Powers of Boards
text: 16-K. A majority of the Adjustment Board, Joint Standing Committee and/or Appeals Board shall have the power to make all appropriate findings, decisions and awards in any and all matters submitted to it pursuant to the provisions of this agreement and to take or to direct the taking of any action which it may deem necessary or proper to make effective the provisions and the 64 intent hereof and to safeguard the rights of the parties hereto or other person. The power, as herein created, shall include, but shall not be - limited to, the reinstatement of any employee found to have been improperly discharged or discriminated against with or without back pay in such amount as the Committee or Board may order and with or without the restoration to prior status, the power to impose damages either in the form of actual or liquidated damages against any party hereto found guilty of a violation of any of the terms, conditions or provisions of this agreement.

name: 16-L. No Oath Required
text: 16-L. Neither the chairman nor any member of the Joint Standing Committee or Adjustment Board need take an oath of office as arbitrator or otherwise and the requirements therefore are hereby expressly waived.

name: 16-M. 1. Selection of Impartial Chairman
text: 16-M. 1. Immediately after the execution of this Agreement, the parties hereto shall meet to select an Impartial Chairman who shall serve commencing with the date of his appointment until] March 30, 1982. On March 1, 1982 and again on March 1, 1983, the rarties hereto shall meet to select a new Impar:ial Chairman who shall serve in each of the second and third years of this Agreement. The Impartial Chairman so selected in each of the second and third years of this Agreement shall serve commencing March 31 of each respective year until the following March 30, unless the parties hereto mutually decide to retain the same Impartial Chairman from one year to the next. In the event that the parties fail to 65 FUNDO000957 designate an Impartial Chairman within twentyone (21) days after the signing of this agreement, the Impartial Chairman shall be selected from a list supplied by the American Arbitration Association in accordance with its then controlling rules and regulations governing such selection.

name: 16-M. 2. Alternate Impartial Chairman
text: 16-M. 2. In addition to the Impartial Chairman to be designated as provided in Section 16-M. 1 of this agreement, an Alternate Impartial Chairman shail be designated in the same manner. The Alternate Impartial Chairman shall become the Impartial Chairman in the event that the incumbent Impartial Chairman is incapacitated or otherwise unable or unwilling to serve. In the event the Alternate Impartial Chairman so becomes the Impartial Chairman (except for a period which the parties mutually declare to be a temporary period, e.g.; hospitalization of the in-- cumbent), then the parties at once shall follow the procedures of Section 16-M. 1 to name a new Alternate Impartial Chairman.

name: 16-M. 3. No Change in Condition
text: No Change in Condition 16-M, 3, With the exception of a layoff, as hereinbefore provided in Section 8-D, and except in ease of discharge of employees, ne change in condition shall be put in effect by either party to this contract without the prior consent of the other. In the event that such change is placed in effect, either party may file formal written demand for a hearing before the Appeals Board without resort to the Joint Standing Committee and said Appeals Board shall be convened immediately and 66 hear and determine the issue within two (2) weeks from the date of the filing of such demand.

name: 16-M. 4. Change in Effect Thirty Days
text: 16-M. 4. In the event a change shall have been made and shall have been in effect for a period of more than thirty (80) days, then the change may be continued in effect pending a determination by the Appeals Board. If the change has not been in effect for more than thirty (80) days, the Union, immediately after filing written notice, may request the chairman designated to serve on the Appeals Board to direct the Publisher who has made the change to discontinue it and to restore the prior existing conditions pending a full hearing by the Appeals Board and its determination, and the Publisher upon receipt of such notice from the chairman shall thereupon immediately _restore the prior existing conditions.

name: 16-M. 5. Impartial Chairman as Fifth Member
text: 16-M. 5. In all grievances concerning change of conditions arising under paragraphs 16-M. 3. and 16-M. 4., the Impartial Chairman selected under 16-M. 1. and 16-M. 2. shall constitute the fifth impartial member of the Appeals Board. The Appeals Board so constituted shall hear and de- ¢eide grievances concerning change vf conditions arising under paragraph 16-M. 8. a d 16-M. 4. exclusively and may only hear an decide the merits of the underlying grievances. differences, or disputes resulting from the particular change of conditions with the consent of both parties.

name: 16-N. No Strike, No Lockout
text: No Strike, No Lockout 16-N. name: 17-A. 2. Reinstatement of Italicized Provisions
text: 17-A.2, I¢ is understood and agreed, however, for the duration of this Agreement, that if any provision as shown above in italics, and as modified from the preceding Agreement or excluded from this Agreement solely because of the restrictions of law, no longer is held to be inoperative, either by legislative enactment or by decision of the court of highest resource, then such provision automatically shall become a part of this Agreement, to the extent permitted, and be in force and effect as though it had been originally made a part hereof.

name: 17-B. Separability Clause
text: Separability Clause 17-B. To the best knowledge and belief of the parties this contract now contains no provision which is contrary to federal or state law or regulation. Should any provision of this contract, at any time during its life, be in conflict with federal or state law or regulation by reason of the passage of any statute, rule, or regulation after the execution of this agreement, or by reason of any 69 FUNDOO00959 een eee a need decision, ruling or decree by any tribunal of competent authority made after the execution of this agreement, then such provision shall become inoperative, either upon agreement by the parties that such conflict exists, or upon a determination to that effect by the Appeals Board. A dispute with respect to the legality of the provision will be subject to arbitration in accordance with the procedures outlined in Section 16 of this contract. In the event that any provision of this contract thus becomes inoperative, the remaining provisions of the contract shall, nevertheless, remain in full force and effect. Either party shall have the right to serve a written request upon the other party to renegotiate on the subject matter of the inoperative provision, so as to conform it to the law. In the event the parties cannot reach agreement, the subject matter of the inoperative provision may be referred by either party to the Appeals Board.

name: 17-C. Spirit and Letter

text: SECTION 18 Suspension and Merger Pay In the event of merger, consolidation, or permanent suspension by any newspaper covered by this agreement all regular situation holders with one (1) year or more of service as regular situation holders who by virtue of the merger, consolidation, or permanent suspension are deprived of regular situations shall receive the cash equivalent of eight weeks (40 shifts) pay at their current rate in addition to any accumulated vacation credits or any other money due them.

name: Section 19 (a). Notice of Desire to Change
text: (a) Seventy-five (75) days prior to the expiration date of this contract either party may give to the other party written notice of its desire to change the contract, along with such changes as it may wish to have made. After the giving of such notice immediate endeavors shall be made to negotiate a new contract. If agreement has not been reached by a date thirty (36) days prior to 71 FUNDOOO00960 tte tke iter Ee oe ewe ) : : FAO Ree ote al th, the expiration date of this contract then by mutual consent the parties may invite a representative of the New York State Board of Mediation or of the Federal Mediation and Conciliation Service, or both, to participate in the remaining days of negotiation.

name: Section 19 (b). Purpose of Seventy-Five Day Notice
text: (b) The giving of notice seventy-five (75) days prior toe the expiration date rather than sixtyfive (65) days prior to the expiration date is in the hope that the parties may arrive at an agreement for a succeeding contract two (2) weeks prior to the expiration date, thereby allowing time for submission to and ratification by the parties hereunto.

name: 22-D. Point Two (i) Over-the-Road Trucking Principle
text: Point Two Paragraph (e) will be construed as if it reads as follows: (i) During the term of this Agreement The Times will begin to apply the principle that all over-the-road trucking now being done by common carrier will be done by employees covered by this Agreement, except for those common carrier runs which extend for more than 250 miles from Columbus Circle or which have more than two stops.

name: 22-D. Point Two (ii) Transfer Point
text: (ii) A run which because of the exceptions provided in Sub-Paragraph (i) or this Paragraph (e) is not driven by an employee covered by this Agreement will be driven to a transfer point by an employee covered by this Agreement. A transfer point is a location where the trailer is un- 92 . SOMMER CUT UN ETS hooked and picked up by a tractor driven by a person not covered by this Agreement or where the newspapers in the trailer are unloaded and carried away in trucks driven by persons not covered by this Agreement. The location of such a transfer point will be selected by The Times, subject to the agreement of the Union. text: {iv) In selecting a transfer point in the case of a run, excepted by Sub-Paragraph (i), which has more than two stops, The Times will pick a location which is no farther from Columbus Circle than 150 miles but no nearer to Columbus Circle than any transfer point in use as of the date of signing of this Agreement, namely: Fairfield, Connecticut; Southfield, New York; and Hightstown, New Jersey.

text: (v) A Times driver at a transfer point where bundles are being unloaded for cartage by others will be responsible for his load; his duties will include checking out the bundles to the consignees.

name: 22-D. Point Two (vi) Benefit Credits
text: (vi) When tractor trailer drivers do not work a fifth shift but have worked 45 hours or more 93 FUNDOO000971 Pkg a en oe Ts in the same payroll week, they will receive benefit credits as if they worked the fifth shift (vacation, sick days, pension and welfare, etc.).

name: 22-D. Point Two (vii) United Runs
text: (vii) By January 1, 1974, The Times will have the NMDU make all United runs from Hightstown to Philadelphia. At the same time, The Times will have the NMDU make daily runs which are presently delivered to United in Jersey City. These will be delivered in straight trucks without tailmen to either Philadelphia or suburban Philadelphia. In the event the new runs result in a jurisdictional dispute which interferes with distribution or causes a substantial sales loss, due to a jurisdictional dispute, The Times will revert to the present delivery procedure until the dispute is resolved.
